scenes.narration: Ask AI to multiply two eight-digit numbers, and the first four digits come out right. Everything after that was wrong.
scenes.main_point: Lead with the result: first four digits right, then wrong
scenes.visual_objective: Lead with the result: first four digits right, then wrong

scenes.narration: Sixteen digits, the right length, and still wrong.
scenes.main_point: Show the model's answer beside the correct product, digit by digit
scenes.visual_objective: Show the model's answer beside the correct product, digit by digit

scenes.narration: We gave Gemini Flash-Lite ten problems at every size, from two digits to ten. Code checked every digit.
scenes.main_point: Show the sizes tested, ten problems each
scenes.visual_objective: Show the sizes tested, ten problems each

scenes.narration: At two digits it was perfect, and from six digits up it got none right.
scenes.main_point: Right answers by size when answering with only the number
scenes.visual_objective: Right answers by size when answering with only the number

scenes.narration: Then we asked it to show its working, and it got twenty-one of twenty-five right.
scenes.main_point: Compare number-only with working shown, six to ten digits
scenes.visual_objective: Compare number-only with working shown, six to ten digits

scenes.narration: So make AI show its working, or check its sums with code. Would you have checked?
scenes.main_point: Close: make AI show its working; ask if the viewer would have checked
